+# European ROM language support
+
+On a DS, the European release of *Explorers of Sky* follows the system's
+language setting. SkyRecompiled generates a firmware image with that setting
+fixed to English. The translations are in the European cartridge. Direct boot
+copies the effective firmware user settings into guest RAM at \`0x027FFC80\`,
+where the game can read them. This path uses FreeBIOS and generated firmware.
+[Nintendo DS language settings](https://en-americas-support.nintendo.com/app/answers/detail/p/606/c/898/a_id/7398)
+
+## In-game settings design
+
+Expose **Game language** for the verified European ROM (\`C2SP\`) in the
+\`recomp-ui\` settings overlay. Offer the following choices in their own language.
+Persist the selection in the host runtime settings and default to English.

+| Français | 2 |
+| Deutsch | 3 |
+| Italiano | 4 |
+| Español | 5 |

+localized resources during startup. Applying the preference at the next boot
+keeps resource initialization on the normal guest path and lets players save
+their progress before closing the game. Existing savestates resume guest RAM
+from the language active when they were captured.

+   generated firmware. With a locally supplied European ROM, confirm the
+   selection persists across a relaunch and the title and dialogue use the
+   selected language. Confirm a cartridge save still loads after switching.
